newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends week higher, awaits March export.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends week higher, awaits March export.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended higher after some late buying emerged in late dealing. Market awaits March export data from SGS (M) Sdn Bhd and Caleb Brett on Monday. Prices are likely to gain further next week if soyoil rise further after the Good Friday and Easter holidays.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market was also marked up in line with futures. RBD palm olein and CPO saw more business.
Two cargo surveyors, SGS (M) Sdn Bhd and Caleb Brett are scheduled to release the March export data on Monday to provide the market a lead, traders said.
The market is expected to extend gains into early next week before trading in a tight range if demand is absent.
"We hope the market will rise slightly next week and shortcovering may emerge if soyoil opens higher after the Easter holidays."
Malaysia's benchmark third position June futures closed at 1,245 ringgit ($502.62) a tonne, up four ringgit. The contract is seen trading between 1,240 and 1,265 ringgit.
"If June futures contract breaks the 1,255 level, it will try to test the next resistance of 1,265," a chartist said.
But some traders said gains could be limited as the fundamental outlook remains uncertain with production in coming months seen rising.
Among physicals, April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,287.50 ringgit against bids of 1,285, after trading at 1,290 and 1,287.50.
April (central) saw offers at 1,275 against bids of 1,270 and April (north) at 1,260 against 1,250.
May south) was offered at 1,280 and bids at 1,272.50 with trades at 1,277.50 and 1,275. May (central) saw offers at 1,270 against 1,265.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $540, June at $535 and July/Aug/Sep at $532.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $582.50, May at $572.50, Jun at $570 and July/Aug/Sep at 565. Apr was traded at $582.50, May at $572.50 and $575, and June at $571 and $572.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
